items.title: FDA expands J&J’s Rybrevant Faspro label with head and neck cancer approval
items.summary: The accelerated approval marks the first indication beyond lung cancer for J&J’s bispecific antibody.

items.title: MHRA champions patient voices through new policy
items.summary: Through its PPIE initiative, the MHRA plans to consider a diverse range of patient and public opinions when making regulatory decisions.

items.title: Armada to combine with Brains Bioceutical in $750m deal
items.summary: Armada Acquisition has entered a definitive business combination agreement with Brains Bioceutical that values the latter at an implied pre-money equity value of $750m.

items.title: Alfasigma receives EC’s expanded approval for filgotinib to treat axSpA
items.summary: Alfasigma has received the EC's expanded approval for Jyseleca to treat adult patients living with active axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA).

items.title: Cordavis to stay in CVS Health after bifurcation of $117bn empire
items.summary: Cordavis was established by CVS Health three years ago to capture more of the US biosimilar supply chain.
